# Blender Studio

> > Blender Studio is the creative production hub and training platform for Blender, featuring open movie projects, comprehensive courses, and production assets.

Blender Studio produces open-source animated films like Spring, Hero, Wing It!, and Project Storm, while offering professional training courses covering modeling, animation, Geometry Nodes, and production workflows. Members gain access to production files, tutorials, and behind-the-scenes content from real film projects.

## Key Topics

- Blender Studio
- Blender
- Geometry Nodes
